fix_assessment.rationale: No existing upstream fix attempt covers the measured work-area recreation path.

issue_context.summary: FancyZones substantially stalls desktop presentation during virtual desktop switches because it rebuilds every work area and cycles overlay windows even when only the virtual desktop ID changed.
known_information: The issue reproduces from PowerToys 0.71 through 0.100.2.
A 0.100.2 A/B PresentMon capture measured about three times the freeze rate and four times frozen duration with FancyZones enabled.
FancyZones logs attribute roughly 80% of the measured switch handling time to freeing and reusing ZonesOverlay windows.
inferences: Preserving work areas across a pure virtual-desktop transition should remove the dominant overlay churn, provided desktop-specific layout identity is updated safely.
issue_context.analysis: Current FancyZones::ShouldWorkAreasBeRecreated returns true whenever the stored virtualDesktopId differs, and UpdateWorkAreas then clears all work areas. The public trace directly measures that path and rules out monitor identification and WMI as primary costs.
initial_investigation: src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesLib/FancyZones.cpp still treats a virtual desktop ID change as a mandatory full recreation.
The same file calls WorkAreaConfiguration::Clear before re-adding every monitor work area.
No pull request referencing issue 27555 was found.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.note: Start the bounded fork-side design workflow. This draft performs no upstream write.

proposed_fixes.title: Preserve FancyZones work areas across pure virtual desktop switches
proposed_fixes.root_cause: ShouldWorkAreasBeRecreated treats a changed virtualDesktopId as a structural monitor change, causing Clear and full overlay/work-area reconstruction on every desktop switch.
plan: Separate structural monitor/work-area changes from virtual-desktop identity changes.
For unchanged monitor geometry, update or swap desktop-specific layout/history state without destroying WorkArea and ZonesOverlay instances.
Retain the full rebuild path for actual monitor, serial, DPI, work-area, or spanning-mode changes and add timing counters.
verification: Run scripted virtual desktop switches under PresentMon and FancyZones trace logging; verify layouts remain correct and overlay recreation/timing drops materially.

confidence.rationale: The current branch, module logs, and controlled A/B measurements all identify the same unconditional rebuild path.
